Description: The gallery opens into a warm, wet chamber lined with leathery eggs the size of a man. Each egg pulses with a faint light. Through the translucent shells, small shapes curl and twitch. The Broodmother is nowhere in sight, but the heat of her passing still lingers.

Replies.SsText: Fire races across the shells and the chamber fills with a thin, terrible shriek. The smoke stings, but the brood will never hatch.
You slip an egg into a padded sack. A collector in the next town will pay handsomely for it.
Replies.FlText: The egg cracks in your hands and the shriek brings the whole brood running.

Replies.SsText: You pick your way between the eggs without disturbing a single one.
Replies.FlText: You slip on the wet floor and fall hard among the eggs, rattling the shells.

Replies.ReplyText: Coax a newly hatched pod to follow you.
Replies.SsText: It rolls into your pack, warm and humming. It does not seem to mind the dark.
Replies.FlText: It bursts in a cloud of spores and you stagger back, coughing.
